evidence_note: Both keys resolve to 2-hydroxy-3-methylpentanoic acid (CID 10796774 with 2R,3R; CID 164623 without stereo), C6H12O3. The Broad name is a group "2-hydroxycaproic and/or 2-hydroxyisocaproic acid" (hexanoic or 4-methylpentanoic), so its InChIKey does not match its own name (E). By name, the rows are positional isomers from leucine vs isoleucine metabolism, so the merge is also wrong (C). The wrong source key may be what caused the merge; not verified.

CID 5497181: all-cis 7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z-docosatetraenoic acid (adrenic acid), C22H36O2; CID 5282844: all-trans 7E,10E,13E,16E isomer, C22H36O2. Adrenic acid is by definition the all-cis form, so the all-trans key does not match its row name (E). Structurally the two keys are stereoisomers (B).

Four rows, four bilirubin geometric isomers (same connectivity). Checked key by key: "bilirubin (E,E)*" carries VVCLLGATSA = CID 5799469, a mixed E/Z isomer; "bilirubin (E,Z or Z,E)*" carries BMNRKXRESA = CID 5315454, the E,E isomer. The two LEOCC keys are swapped relative to their names (E). All pairs are stereoisomers (B). The E,Z row is also a group name.

Broad key USOAJAOKSA = CID 12594, natural DHEA sulfate, C19H28O5S. LEOCC key DYIPZHMLSA is not in PubChem. Recomputed from the LEOCC SMILES with RDKit: its InChI stereo layer differs from natural DHEA-S at three ring-junction centres, so the LEOCC structure is a different stereoisomer, not DHEA-S (E).

Broad key GYPHWSFCSA = CID 12544, glycochenodeoxycholic acid, C26H43NO5. LEOCC key AZDOMVTHSA is not in PubChem; it matches the LEOCC SMILES, but compared with the reference structure atom by atom (RDKit) it has C14 inverted and C10 unspecified. A different stereoisomer, not glycochenodeoxycholic acid (E).

Broad key OETIFKLTSA = CID 115245, glycolithocholic acid, C26H43NO4; it matches a reference structure. LEOCC key PGVYWSLXSA is not in PubChem; it matches the LEOCC SMILES, which compared atom by atom with the reference (RDKit) has C13 and C17 inverted. A different stereoisomer, not glycolithocholic acid (E).

CID 105074: pregnenolone sulfate, C21H32O5S (Broad and LEOCC rows agree). CID 22460674: 17-acetyl saturated steroid sulfate (a pregnanolone sulfate), C21H34O5S. The source InChIKey does not match its own name "pregnenediol sulfate" (diol, one ring double bond). Formula differs from pregnenolone sulfate, so the MetLinkR merge is also wrong.

Broad key HZAMXZRMSA = CID 6675, taurocholic acid (9S), C26H45NO7S. LEOCC key HGVCTONRSA = CID 131632375, which is 9R, a C9 epimer, not taurocholic acid (E). The LEOCC key matches the LEOCC SMILES, so the structure in the source file is wrong, not only the key.

Broad rows (group name "Taurdeoxycholic and or Taurochenodeoxycholic acid" and "Taurodeoxycholic acid") share key VAYUFCLWSA = CID 2733768, taurodeoxycholic acid, C26H45NO6S; confirmed against a reference structure. LEOCC key RZGBOAIJSA is not in PubChem; it matches the LEOCC SMILES, which has C9 inverted compared with the reference (RDKit). Not taurodeoxycholic acid (E). The Broad group name also includes the LEOCC compound's intended identity (D), but E is more severe.

CID 9848818: tauroursodeoxycholic acid (3,7-dihydroxy, 7S = 7-beta), full stereo, C26H45NO6S; CID 51066518: same 3,7-dihydroxy skeleton with 7S, some centres unspecified, C26H45NO6S. The Broad row is named "Taurodeoxycholic acid" (a 3,12-dihydroxy compound), but its structure is 3,7-dihydroxy. Name does not match structure (E). Structurally the two keys are partial vs full stereo of the same compound (D).

CID 439887: (2S)-2-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid; CID 439885: (2R)-2-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid, both C18H36O3. The keys give opposite enantiomers, but neither name specifies stereo. Each source probably assigned stereo arbitrarily, so the merge may be correct at the level actually measured.

CID 114833: androsterone glucuronide (5-alpha), C25H38O8; second key not found in PubChem. Etiocholanolone is the 5-beta epimer of androsterone, so the glucuronides are stereoisomers differing at C5. Biologically distinct (5-alpha vs 5-beta reductase pathways). Neither name states stereo with R/S or alpha/beta tokens.

CID 6267: asparagine, C4H8N2O3; CID 496: N1-acetylspermidine, C9H21N3O. Unrelated compounds. Source row IDs point to acetylspermidine (HMDB0002189, HMDB0001276), none to asparagine: MetLinkR error, not source error. Source IDs are comma-separated lists; check later whether that triggers the mismatch.

CID 6453725: SM d18:1/18:0 (stearoyl SM), C41H83N2O6P. "SM 36:1;O2" is the species-level name that includes it (D). Third row is a Metabolon group (d18:1/20:2, d18:2/20:1, d16:1/22:2) that sums to SM 38:3, not 36:1: different compounds, wrongly merged (C). Its InChIKey is not in PubChem, which is expected for a group representative.

CID 853180: (2S)-2-hydroxy-3-methylbutanoic acid, C5H10O3; CID 99823: same compound without stereo, C5H10O3. Both are 2-hydroxyisovaleric acid. The Broad name is a group (2-hydroxyvaleric and/or 2-hydroxyisovaleric) that includes the Metabolon compound, and its key points to a group member, so no source error. Stereo specified vs unspecified is also broader/narrower.

CID 6999745: (3S)-3-methyladipic acid; CID 12292: 3-methyladipic acid without stereo, both C7H12O4. One row is a group (3-methyladipic and/or pimelic acid) that includes the compound. Keys differ only by stereo, which no name specifies. [If row_ids confirm: two of the rows come from the same Broad file.]

CID 10133: chenodeoxycholic acid with full stereo including side chain 4R (C20), C24H40O4; CID 44754955: same compound with all ring stereocentres but the side chain centre unspecified, C24H40O4. Partially vs fully specified stereo (D). Both keys carry stereo, so this is not a UHFFFAOYSA case.
CID 5997: cholesterol with all 8 stereocentres specified, C27H46O; CID 6432564: same skeleton with only 3S specified, C27H46O. Partially vs fully specified stereo (D). Both keys carry stereo.

CID 221493: cholic acid with full stereo including 5S (5-beta), C24H40O5; CID 11350342: same with C5 unspecified, C24H40O5. Partially vs fully specified stereo (D). The unspecified C5 covers both cholic acid (5-beta) and allocholic acid (5-alpha). Both keys carry stereo.

CID 5282725: (E)-dec-3-enoic acid, C10H18O2; CID 5282724: (E)-dec-2-enoic acid, C10H18O2. Metabolon name "(2 or 3)-decenoate" is a reported group that includes 3-decenoic acid. Its source InChIKey points to the 2-isomer only, so the key is more specific than the name.

Three rows, two keys: LEOCC "deoxycholate" and two Broad "Deoxycholic acid" rows with the same key. CID 222528: deoxycholic acid with full stereo, C24H40O4; the other key is the same compound with 13R unspecified, C24H40O4. Partially vs fully specified stereo (D). Broad reports the compound twice.

LEOCC key WYWMIBKRSA = CID 6508, quinic acid with full stereo, C7H12O6. Broad key LNVDRNJUSA is not in PubChem. The Broad SMILES is quinic acid with only two of four stereocentres set (marked relative), so the relationship is partial vs full stereo (D). The Broad stored key does not match its own SMILES (recomputed key ZHQZDSKASA), so the key itself cannot be checked.

CID 5780: D-sorbitol with full stereo, C6H14O6; CID 453: hexane-hexol without stereo, C6H14O6. "mannitol/sorbitol" is a group name that includes sorbitol, and its key has no stereo, so it matches the group honestly (D).

CID 21124703: tauro-beta-muricholic acid, full stereo, C26H45NO7S; CID 168408: same 3R,5R,6S,7R configuration with C8, C9, C14 unspecified, C26H45NO7S. Both structures are the beta form (partial vs full stereo, D). The Broad name "Tauromuricholic acid" does not say alpha or beta. PubChem lists CID 168408 under alpha synonyms although its structure has the beta configuration at C6/C7.

CID 135191: xylose, cyclic pyranose form (oxane-tetrol), C5H10O5; CID 644160: xylose, open-chain aldehyde form, C5H10O5. Same sugar in ring vs open-chain form. The merge is correct, but the InChIKeys differ at block1. No category fits; same compound in a different structural representation.
